observations.title: Nevados de Chillan volcano (Chile)
observations.description: The Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería (SERNAGEOMIN) and the Servicio Geológico Minero Argentino (SEGEMAR) reported that eruptive activity at Nevados de Chillán was ongoing in mid-October. A new lava flow was first visible at the summit of Nuevo volcano on 29 September and traveled SW. During a field visit on 1 October scientists observed the ejection of meter-sized blocks as high as 500 m above the summit and outward as far as 250 m. The blocks landed on the flanks and rolled up to 400 m from the crater rim. During 8-14 October activity was characterized by periodic long-period earthquakes indicating fluid movement at depth, and occasional ash plumes and explosions. Weather conditions sometimes prevented views. At 1655 on 8 October an ash plume rose 860 m above the summit and drifted SE. A long-period earthquake was detected at 0330 on 12 October and was associated with the ejection of incandescent material onto the upper flanks. At 1224 on 12 October an ash plume rose 500 m and drifted SSE. A series of consecutive explosions around midday on 13 October produced ash plumes that rose as high as 600 m above the summit, with the tallest plume recorded at 1354. A long-period earthquake was detected at 1548 on 13 October along with an acoustic signal indicating explosive activity; weather conditions prevented visual confirmation. An ash plume rose 400 m at 1558 on 14 October. A few hours later, at 1957, another seismic signal indicated explosive activity. The Alert Level remained at Yellow (the second lowest level on a four-color scale) and the public was warned that an eruption may impact areas within 2 km of the active crater. The Sistema y Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Repuesta Ante Desastres (SENAPRED) maintained an ?Preventive Early Alert? for Pinto and Coihueco and warned the public to stay 2 km away from Emission Center 3 (EC3). Sources: Servicio Geológico Minero Argentino (SEGEMAR),Servicio Nacional de Geología y Minería (SERNAGEOMIN),Sistema y Servicio Nacional de Prevención y Repuesta Ante Desastres (SENAPRED)
